status: admission protocol only; learned mechanism and comparator execution not implemented
families: rotated SPD quadratic with condition numbers 1-100
regularized logistic regression on synthetic fixed-support/query data
comparators: training-tuned two-pair L-BFGS without line search
oracle: Identical scalar loss interface and fixed-direction geometry for every method. No analytic gradients, Hessians, optimum or holdout loss supplied. Compute gradient estimates inside each method or shared pure decoder.
metaObjective: Fixed training-support population within one three-generation chain. Separate chain seeds. Fresh holdout each generation; never used for selection.
stateIdentity: History belongs to an objective ID and target dimension; reject reuse after objective or dimension changes. Fresh downstream tasks always start empty, in every arm.
budget: Eight loss queries per update, no free line search or acceptance queries. Same 33-candidate training search and maximum unroll budget. Extra arithmetic, actual wall time, bytes, scalar queries and invalid proposals reported. No hidden retry search.
primary: Final-generation fresh-target loss contrast current-vs-fixed proposer with identical retained-history policy, separate per family; median relative reduction >= 1% and exact one-sided sign p < 0.025 per family across 12 seeds. Tie tolerance 1e-6 relative. Must also beat both tuned comparators to claim practical optimizer advantage.
secondary: State-retention effect within fixed proposer, interaction with proposer evolution, cold reconstruction parity. No alternate primary chosen afterward.
publication: Source and aggregate report permitted; generated private receipts remain local. No GPU or production change.
